events.description: 35. SCHEDULING ORDER - In preparation for the Court's preliminary injunction hearing that is scheduled for Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. in Courtroom 15B, the Court requests that each party file: (1) a Witness List, identifying each witness that the party expects to call and providing an estimate of the anticipated length of direct examination; and (2) an Exhibit List, identifying each exhibit that the party intends to offer in evidence. If these documents can be filed on Monday, August 31, 2026, that would be much appreciated, but they must be filed no later than 8:00 a.m. on Tuesday, September 1st. In addition, each party should inform the Court whether that party consents or objects to the Court advancing the trial on the merits and consolidating the preliminary injunction hearing with a trial on the merits, pursuant to Rule 65(a)(2) of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure. Ordered by Judge Michael H. Simon. (mja) (Entered: 08/30/2026)
